unit_attributes.statement: This text is an invented visitor-center policy for diagnostic purposes, not legal guidance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Before entering the center; does not apply to overnight staff.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must register before entering the center, except overnight staff who are exempt from this registration duty.
Visitors are not required to wear a badge.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Inside the center; does not apply to maintenance workers performing repairs.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must not carry metal tools inside the center, except that this prohibition does not apply to maintenance workers performing repairs.
Visitors may carry paper maps under this policy, though other building policies may impose additional restrictions.
Other building policies may impose additional restrictions.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Overnight staff regarding registration before entering the center.
unit_attributes.statement: Overnight staff are exempt from the duty in paragraph a to register before entering the center.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Maintenance workers performing repairs inside the center.
unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers performing repairs are exempt from the metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c.
Maintenance workers may carry metal tools while performing repairs.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the visitor desk is busy.
unit_attributes.statement: A delay may occur when the visitor desk is busy.
Staff should record the arrival time of each visitor.
